note: issue 657 (PER-1): the mode of every SQLite table the sources create, as the code does it today. `upsert` means upsert with no history: it is the truth for most tables and is flagged legacy under the ratchet (new tables are append-only or upsert-with-history; migrating the legacy ones is a separate issue). test/architecture-registers.test.mjs checks the register against every CREATE TABLE under packages/*/src.

reprocessings.note: one row per finished reprocessing; INSERT OR REPLACE rewrites done_at

sessions.note: ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE; previous values are not kept

agents.note: ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE; previous values are not kept

events.note: ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; the one exception is setEventText, which rewrites data.text to backfill a transcript text

token_usage.note: INSERT OR REPLACE per session, model and speed; previous totals are not kept

model_pricing.note: INSERT OR REPLACE by pattern, and a delete; previous prices are not kept

accounts.note: ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE; previous values are not kept

session_plans.note: current plan per session, overwritten in place by ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE; plan/recording.ts writes each plan run (closed and open) to session_plan_history on every change, so a run is kept but the intermediate step changes inside one run are not; rebuildPlan deletes the history and rewrites it from the append-only events

session_plan_history.note: the history of session_plans, but written by INSERT OR REPLACE on (session_id, seq) and deleted per session on reimport, so it is not append-only

context_meters.note: ON CONFLICT (session_id, agent_key) DO UPDATE; the latest reading only

decisions.note: decisions/sqlite.ts writes ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET choice = excluded.choice, ...: an in-place edit drops the prior values. Supersession (supersedes and superseded_by) keeps a chain of rows only when a new decision replaces one; edits in place are not historized

session_links.note: ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE; previous parent is not kept

telemetry_samples.note: samples keyed by (machine_id, taken_at), written by INSERT OR REPLACE and pruned by DELETE: append-like in use, not by contract

installation_settings.note: ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE and a delete; previous values are not kept

tool_checks.note: a machine snapshot: DELETE by machine then INSERT; previous checks are not kept

runtime_runs.note: a state machine updated in place (state, turn_id); no transition history

runtime_requests.note: a state machine updated in place (pending, claimed, invalidated); no transition history

work_board_columns.note: despite the name, only the current column and since when per item; ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE

github_cache.note: a cache: ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE and deletes; losing a row is harmless

work_execution_runs.note: the last run per item_key; ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE

work_queue.note: a mutable queue: rows are inserted, updated (position, target, failure) and deleted

work_plan_runs.note: the last run per item_key; ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
